description: Empirical part-load efficiency curve for a biomass CHP plant. Rated electrical/thermal efficiencies x a part-load multiplier (np.interp over PLR breakpoints). Numbers reused from EC144 F1b.
source: Obernberger & Thek (2008) Pellet Handbook; EN303-5:2012; Jenkins et al. (1998)

eta_electrical_ref.note: Electric efficiency at rated, dry fuel

partload_curve.comment: Part-load multiplier on rated efficiency vs PLR. 1.0 at PLR=1, drops at low load (Obernberger part-load polynomial a0=0.65,a1=0.45,a2=-0.15 tabulated).
